movies.title: Genius
movies.overview: An orphan, with a brilliant mind, joins RAW and is burdened by the killing of his entire team. Until he doesn't avenge their death, he can't live in peace with his love. So, he hatches a genius plan.

movies.title: Iron Man
movies.overview: After being held captive in an Afghan cave, billionaire engineer Tony Stark creates a unique weaponized suit of armor to fight evil.

movies.title: Dhoom 3
movies.overview: To avenge his father's death, a circus entertainer trained in magic and acrobatics robs banks to take down a corrupt bank owner. Two cops from Mumbai are assigned to the case.

movies.title: WALL·E
movies.overview: A small waste-collecting robot, left alone to clean a garbage-covered Earth, discovers a new purpose when he meets EVE, a sleek search robot — and follows her into space on an adventure that decides humanity's future.

movies.title: Iron Man 2
movies.overview: With the world now knowing he is Iron Man, Tony Stark refuses to hand his armour technology to the military while the reactor in his chest slowly poisons him. A vengeful Russian physicist builds his own arc-powered weapon and teams up with a rival arms maker, forcing Stark to forge new alliances and a new element to survive.

movies.title: Iron Man 3
movies.overview: Still shaken after the battle of New York, Tony Stark is targeted by the Mandarin, a terrorist whose bombings leave no trace. When his Malibu home is destroyed and he is stranded in Tennessee with a failing suit, Stark has to rebuild from nothing, untangle the Extremis conspiracy behind the attacks, and prove the man matters more than the armor.

movies.title: Need for Speed
movies.overview: Framed by his wealthy ex-partner for a crime he didn't commit, mechanic and street racer Tobey Marshall does two years in prison, then enters a coast-to-coast supercar race to settle the score. The ex-partner answers with a bounty on his head, turning the run into a gauntlet of illegal racers, cop chases and supercharged wrecks standing between Tobey and California.

movies.title: Avatar: Fire and Ash
movies.overview: Grieving their eldest son after the war against the RDA, Jake Sully and Neytiri run into a darker threat: the Ash People, a fire-hardened Na'vi clan under the ruthless Varang who throw in with the humans hunting them. To protect their family and Pandora itself, the Sullys must face an enemy that fights dirtier than any they have met.

movies.title: Monarch: Legacy of Monsters — Season 1
movies.overview: After surviving Godzilla's attack on San Francisco, Cate is shaken yet again by a shocking secret. Amid monstrous threats, she embarks on a globetrotting adventure to learn the truth about her family—and the mysterious organization known as Monarch.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
movies.overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.
